title: Examples of generative procedures for AI agents
establishes: Order example validates five-digit order numbers and email, escalates after two invalid entries, then checks status. Damaged-item example collects order/product/damage, asks for a photo and submits a ticket for support follow-up.
limitations: Illustrative company procedures, not universal Zendesk policy. Conversation wording and refund notification do not confer refund API authority.

title: Best practices for writing generative procedures for AI agents
relevant_section: Sequential order; conditions and actions; errors
establishes: Recommends specific terminology, sequential steps, explicit conditions, and error handling.
limitations: Its language-performance claim is not evidence about our model or Vietnamese translations.

title: Ticket trigger conditions and actions reference
establishes: Conditions can inspect ticket fields; actions can assign groups and update ticket attributes.
limitations: Does not define our group names or risk classification rules. Not a complete trigger-engine simulation.

title: Planning your workflow
relevant_section: Groups; Roles; Ticket fields; Ticket forms
establishes: Planning should identify roles, group purposes, ticket fields needed for routing and resolution, and required submission fields.
limitations: Does not prescribe our required-field set.

title: Workflow recipes reference
establishes: Indexes request forms, escalation and approval workflow recipes.
limitations: Index only; linked recipes were not inspected and supply no policy details here.

title: Triage and route AI-powered support tickets with Google Gemini, Trello, and Gmail
relevant_section: Quick overview; How it works steps 1–7
establishes: Stops out-of-scope requests; creates a card; asks a human to approve the proposed reply; approved replies are sent and cards resolved; rejected cards go to Manual Review.
limitations: Description inspected, full n8n JSON not retrieved. Priority classification and integrations omitted. Relative update date not converted.

title: Route and respond to support tickets with Google Sheets, Slack, and Gemini
establishes: Validates required fields, rejects invalid payloads, routes high-risk cases to human escalation and records interactions.
limitations: No universal routing thresholds. Deduplication, retrieval, daily reporting and actual integrations omitted. Full JSON not retrieved.

title: Business Process Model & Notation
establishes: Process diagrams connect business process design to implementation.
limitations: Overview only. Genie DSL is neither BPMN compliant nor BPMN XML.

title: Decision Model and Notation
relevant_section: Precise specification of business decisions and business rules
establishes: Explicit decisions and business rules complement process models.
limitations: No DMN/FEEL interpreter or conformance claim.

title: τ-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
establishes: Evaluates policy-guided tool agents through final database state compared with annotated goals; studies repeated-trial reliability.
limitations: Abstract read, no dataset reused; our snapshot runner is not τ-bench or pass^k replication.

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
establishes: Studies LLM judging and position, verbosity, self-enhancement and reasoning limitations.
limitations: Human preference evaluation does not establish workflow correctness. No published scores transferred.

title: G-Eval: NLG Evaluation using GPT-4 with Better Human Alignment
establishes: Studies structured form-based LLM evaluation of summarization/dialogue and possible preference for generated text.
limitations: Our short evidence rubric is an adaptation, not G-Eval reproduction or hidden chain-of-thought collection.

title: A Survey on LLM-as-a-Judge
establishes: Reviews judge reliability, consistency and bias mitigation.
limitations: Only abstract/metadata inspected; no exhaustive literature review or claimed workflow benchmark results.

title: WorkflowJudge (title supplied by user; unverified)
limitations: Firecrawl retrieval failed; exact title/DOI search returned no results. Not used to ground a method or business rule.

title: Structured outputs
relevant_section: Generating structured JSON with a schema; Tips
establishes: Pass JSON Schema in format, include schema in prompt, validate output and use low temperature.
limitations: Schema constrains shape, not semantics. Local HTTP adapter chosen to avoid dependencies.
